sn11.18:1.3: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Mātalisaṅgāhakam āmantesi || ||
sn11.18:1.4: Yojehi samma Mātali sahassayuttam ājaññaratham || uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyā ti || || 4.
sn11.18:1.5: Evam bhadanta vā ti kho bhikkhave Mātali-saṅgāhako Sakkassa devānam indassa paṭissutvā sahassayuttam ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā Sakkassa devānam indassa paṭivedesi || ||
sn11.18:1.6: Yutto kho te mārisa sahassayutto ājaññaratho
sn11.18:1.8: Atha kho bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo Vejayantapāsādā orohanto pañjaliko sudaṃ puthuddisā namassati || || 6.
sn11.18:1.9: Atha kho bhikkhave Mātali-saṅgāhako Sakkam devānam indaṃ gāthāyo ajjhabhāsi || || 7.
